choice.basis: The chart shows the January bar's top edge aligning exactly with the dashed horizontal reference line at the 150 level on the y-axis. This dashed line is explicitly labeled 'Average'. The O and B checks confirm that the bars represent monthly alert-day totals and the dashed line represents the monthly average level. Since January's value coincides with the average line, it falls into the average-level category.
choice.option_label: Route January to average-level alert monitoring
